quality_guards: Wood-dust risk depends on wood species, process, dust concentration, particle size, exposure duration, extraction performance and worker susceptibility.
HSE wood-dust evidence is process-, material-, workplace-, control-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Nail-gun risk depends on tool type, trigger system, pressure or power, fastener, workpiece, access, maintenance, training and user behaviour.
HSE powered-fastening evidence is tool-, task-, fastener-, worker-, workplace- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Overhead-line risk depends on voltage, clearance, equipment dimensions, route, weather, ground conditions, supervision and line-owner controls.
HSE overhead-line evidence is line-, site-, task-, equipment-, worker- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level electrocution probability.
Maintenance risk depends on equipment, energy sources, degradation, isolation, access, competence, contractors, environment and task planning.
HSE maintenance evidence is equipment-, task-, energy-, worker-, workplace- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Mumps risk depends on vaccination history, immunity, contact intensity, setting, age, outbreak status, testing and timing.
UKHSA mumps evidence is case-, contact-, vaccine-, setting-, laboratory- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Hepatitis-E risk depends on food source, cooking, sanitation, travel, pregnancy, immune status, liver disease, exposure timing and viral genotype.
UKHSA hepatitis-E evidence is source-, food-, traveller-, patient-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
TB risk depends on infectiousness, contact duration, ventilation, setting, host susceptibility, migration history, screening, treatment and timing.
UKHSA tuberculosis evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, screening-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level transmission probability.
Baby-bath-seat risk depends on product design, support, stability, attachment, child size, water depth, supervision, condition and use.
OPSS baby-bath-seat evidence is product-, marketplace-, child-, use-, corrective-action- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level drowning probability.
CFIT risk depends on terrain, procedure, altimeter setting, navigation, weather, aircraft performance, crew monitoring and air-traffic service.
CAA CFIT evidence is aircraft-, procedure-, crew-, terrain-, weather- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Rail-civils risk depends on asset age, condition, hidden defects, drainage, weather, loading, inspection, monitoring and mitigation.
ORR civil-engineering evidence is asset-, route-, weather-, inspection-, mitigation- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level derailment probability.
